chapter: Hampton, New York and Lee's own band
title: Leaving Cafe Society when his father fell ill
summary: After two or three months at Cafe Society, Lee left the band to go home because his father was gravely ill.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: So I'll go back and see if I can get out of New York. I told you that we went back to the Cafe Society, okay?

I think we were there 2 or 3 months or something, and my father -- you know, our father became very, very ill; well, and my mother and I were very, very close -- and so when she told me that they were not expecting my father to live, then I left the band and came home. But you know, there's one story in the Billy Berg that I have to tell you, at from the beginning.
